mechanism: NSAIDs and analgesics may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of ARBs like candesartan and increase risk of renal impairment; chronic acetaminophen use at high doses can affect renal function and potentially reduce candesartan effectiveness.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and renal function periodically; use acetaminophen at the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration, particularly in elderly patients or those with pre-existing renal disease.
